name: Interdisciplinary Psychiatry
note: Five research talks and a panel on computational psychiatry, eye tracking for autism and digital sensing of mental health.

name: Brain Research at the Molecular and Cellular Level
note: Four long sessions from the Safra Center for Brain Sciences on molecular and cellular neuroscience research.

name: What Works for Borderline Personality Disorder?
note: International conference on borderline personality disorder with talks on DBT, TFP and MBT by Fruzzetti, Yeomans and Fonagy, plus a family perspective.

name: The Degenerating Brain: From Research to Hope
note: Twelve-lesson course on the molecular and cellular pathways of Alzheimer's, Parkinson's and ALS, taught by Hermona Soreq and Sebastian Kadener.

name: ELSC Seminars and Lectures
note: Seminars and named lectures from the Edmond and Lily Safra Center for Brain Sciences, including Shadlen and Kleinfeld.

name: The Psychology of Language
note: NPTEL course on communication, speech perception and production, and how words are stored and understood.

name: Consumer Psychology
note: NPTEL course following the buying process: problem recognition, evaluating alternatives, purchase and consumption.

name: Psychology of Emotion: Theory and Applications
note: 32 lectures on emotion theories, culture, the body and brain, and social emotions like guilt, envy and jealousy, taught by Dilwar Hussain.

name: Human Behaviour
note: NPTEL introduction to the science of behavior: sensation, perception, learning, memory and beyond.

name: Psychology of Stress, Health and Well-being
note: 35 lectures on the biology of stress, its links to illness, trauma and posttraumatic growth, and stress tolerance.

name: Language, Culture and Cognition: An Introduction
note: Cognitive linguistics course on categorization, frames, metaphor and image schemas, linking language to thought.

name: Bilingualism: A Cognitive and Psycholinguistic Perspective
note: Course on bilingual acquisition, cognition, memory models and the bilingual brain.

name: Organizational Behaviour: Individual Dynamics in Organization
note: 60 short lectures on individual differences, diversity and inclusion at work, taught by Abraham Cyril Issac.

name: Child's Growth and Development
note: Foundational course on physical, motor and later stages of development from infancy to adolescence, aimed at teachers.

name: Adolescent Health and Well-being: A Holistic Approach
note: Course on adolescent health covering nutrition, mental health, and physical and psychological change in the teen years.

name: Behavioral and Personal Finance
note: 42 lectures on behavioral economics: decisions under risk, prospect theory and behavioral biases in money choices.

name: Selected Topics in Psychology
note: IIT Kanpur course by nine professors on Indian psychology, culture and self, attraction and organizational behavior.

name: Contemporary Issues in Philosophy of Mind and Cognition
lecturer: Ranjan K. Panda and Rajakishore Nath
note: IIT Bombay course from Plato and Upanishadic views of mind through dualism to modern theories of consciousness and cognition.

name: Sports Psychology
note: 41-part IIT Madras course on mental training, flow, goal setting, imagery, resilience and burnout in athletes.

name: Neuroscience of Human Movement
note: 83 lectures from membrane physiology and action potentials to the cerebellum, basal ganglia and spinal cord injury.

name: BRAIN Initiative Cell Atlas Workshop
note: Three-day NIH workshop on integrating single-cell genomic data to understand brain function and disorders.

name: Global Mental Health Research Webinar Series
note: NIMH webinars for early-career researchers on stratification, human subjects protection and RDoC in global mental health research.

name: Three-Minute Talks

name: NIMH Director's Innovation Speaker Series
note: Talks on neurotechnology ethics, youth media research and youth suicidal behavior.

name: Science Behind Addiction
note: One-minute question-and-answer clips on addiction during COVID-19, not full talks.

name: Embodied, Situated, and Grounded Intelligence: Implications for AI
note: Santa Fe Institute workshop with Bengio, Casanto, Glenberg and others on embodied cognition and grounded language in minds and machines.

name: Presidential Lectures 2026: Brain and Body
note: Simons Foundation lectures on two-way communication between brain, gut, hormones and immune system.

name: Simons Collaboration on the Global Brain Annual Meeting
note: 2025 meeting talks on brain-wide neural activity, with Pouget, Rust and Leifer.

name: Presidential Lectures 2025: Diverse Brains
note: Simons lectures by O'Connell, Tosches, Pena and Marder on how brains differ across species.

name: Presidential Lectures 2023: The Neuroscience of Sleep
note: Three Simons lectures on sleep genetics, sleep and memory, and why we sleep, by Ptacek, Frank and Dan.

name: Presidential Lectures 2024: The Social Brain
note: Simons lectures by Adolphs, Freiwald and Robinson on the neural and genomic basis of social behavior.

name: Simons Foundation Autism Lectures

name: Autism: Emerging Concepts
note: Simons lecture series on new ideas in autism science, with Kanwisher, Fishell, Dulac and others.

name: LLMs, Cognitive Science, Linguistics, and Neuroscience
note: February 2025 Simons Institute workshop on what language models reveal about human language and the brain.

name: Understanding Higher-level Intelligence from AI, Psychology, and Neuroscience
note: Workshop talks on social intelligence, language, creativity and consciousness in humans and large models.

name: The Brain and Computation Boot Camp
note: Tutorials on connectomics, biophysics of neurons and thalamocortical computation, given by Lichtman, Maass, Mel and Olshausen.

name: Computational Theories of the Brain
note: Workshop on predictive coding, learning in neural networks and links between computational neuroscience and machine learning.

name: Targeted Discovery in Brain Data
note: Workshop on algorithms for finding structure in neural recordings, from navigation circuits to cortical communication.
